properties.name: Rothwell curated visitor boundary
properties.methodology: Morphological closing of the preserved official built-up-area geometry using a 150 metre outward and inward buffer. This fills internal omissions for connected parks, river corridors and visitor green spaces without applying a general outward town buffer.

project.boundarySource: Curated Rothwell visitor boundary derived from ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024)
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon.
